question_intents: How do non-contact safety sensors function for collision avoidance?
data.summary: This section details non-contact safety sensors used for collision avoidance in AGVs, specifically describing ultrasonic scanners that assist in environmental localization and distance calculation. It outlines the operational logic of these sensors, which utilize a yellow warning zone to trigger safe speed reduction and a red emergency zone to initiate an immediate stop, thereby protecting personnel and preventing mechanical damage.
